prompts.H1: Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Repaint the H1 building in image 1 for Valdoria, a 2D medieval pixel-art RPG. Images 2 and 3 are the OFFICIAL ANIME Release That Witch, not the manhua. Follow the impoverished outer-town aesthetic: pale dirty lime plaster between dark exposed timber posts and diagonal braces; weathered gray-brown roofs, restrained gray rubble foundation. This is a lived-in poor kingdom suffering neglect and corruption, not a tidy new model village. Show irregular replacement shingles, worn edges and one or two subtle repaired roof areas; cracked/missing patches of plaster exposing rough infill, uneven reused boards and stained lower walls. Sparse functional fittings. Keep structural believability and habitation, no collapsed ruin or huge open roof holes. Clear broad material planes and crisp pixel clusters instead of gold flecks/noise. Atmosphere sober and subdued, upper-left overcast illumination with cool recesses, no global black/gray tint. CRITICAL: preserve image 1 exact 3/4 projection, camera, silhouette, dimensions, footprint/base outline, doorway head and foot positions, all windows, roof mass and existing annexes. Do NOT copy a log shed or other annex from another building.  Entire single building on true transparent background, with no floor plane, vignette, fog, glow, cast backdrop, text, people or extra objects. Clean alpha outside the structure, keep source aspect ratio. Repaint surfaces, do not simply hue-shift.
